content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a small project and need a compact controller similar to [product_name]. However, I want to connect it with an HMI (PC-based or otherwise). Can [product_name] communicate with an HMI, and does it support LAN connectivity? Thank you, [user_name]
The upcoming [product_name] (not released yet) will include Ethernet communication capabilities. See [url] for further details. Best regards,

Yes, if you wait until the summer, [company_name] will introduce the new version [article_no]. It will allow connections to HMIs via Ethernet. Alternatively, you could use the current [product_name] with [product_name] operator device, but it won’t support LAN.
Thanks, [user_name]. I guess I’ll need to consider different options; maybe I’ll use another controller such as [version_no]. Regards,
I suggest using [version_no] instead of [version_no] for your needs. Best regards, [user_name]

That’s a good suggestion. The [version_no] model is becoming outdated and will be discontinued soon. Its Ethernet communication isn’t reliable and HMI integration via Ethernet isn’t possible, only point-to-point is supported.
True, I forgot about that. I’ll try my luck with [version_no] since this will be my first experience with it. Thanks everyone.

It’s currently not possible, but once the new [article_no] model is released, it will be a significant improvement. You'll be able to connect: [product_name]-[product_name], [product_name]-[version_no], [product_name]-HMI, and [product_name]-PC.
Hi, For more information regarding [product_name], check [url]. Hope this helps!
How will the communication parameters be configured? Will it be similar to [version_no]? Or will there be a new program for HMI design?
Hi [user_name], If you want to use [product_name] in flex, choose [version_no], since no new dedicated software exists for [product_name]. Best regards
I heard that [product_name] ([article_no]) will communicate with HMIs in the same way that [version_no] does. I believe [article_no] will be a great solution, bringing many useful new features.

Just wanted to mention that I tried one of the latest models and achieved a connection with an HMI (both panel and PC runtime) using [product_name] software. You’ll need to configure an [version_no] connection—TSAP settings should match those used for connecting [version_no] to an HMI via Ethernet. These settings can be checked using the Ethernet wizard in [product_name] software.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are interested in connecting small controllers like [product_name] to HMIs using LAN/Ethernet. The current [product_name] does not support Ethernet or HMI connectivity via LAN, but the forthcoming version ([article_no]) is expected to provide these features. Users seeking immediate solutions have considered switching to other [company_name] controllers, showing that LAN-based HMI connectivity is an important requirement for their applications.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect simple Ethernet communication between [product_name] and HMI devices to enable flexible automation workflows, ideally without needing to use larger or older controllers.
